meta.name: tech-stack-architecture-decision
meta.description: Define and document the technology stack and architecture decisions for a project. Use when the user needs to choose a tech stack, make architecture decisions, define infrastructure choices, or document technology selections. Triggers on requests like "define the tech stack", "choose technologies", "architecture decisions", "what stack should we use", or any request to select and document frontend, backend, database, auth, hosting, and infrastructure choices for a project.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你为项目选定技术栈并记录架构决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在启动新项目需要确定技术方案
copy.tagline_en: Choose and document your project's tech stack and architecture decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're starting a new project and need to define its technical approach

howto.what: 安装后,当你请它做技术选型时,它会先提问了解项目情况,再生成一份技术栈与架构决策文档,涵盖项目概览、架构风格、各层技术选型、架构图、关键决策和开发环境,并可根据反馈修改。
howto.when: 当你提到“define the tech stack”“choose technologies”等关键词,或要求为项目选择并记录前端、后端、数据库等技术方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个 Web 应用定技术栈和架构。
say.note: 会先提问,再生成决策文档。

say.text: 请生成一份技术栈与架构决策文档。
say.note: 直接分析已知信息并产出文档。

say.text: 给这个项目的技术选型写明理由和替代方案。
say.note: 会生成含 ADR 的文档。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude asks questions first, then produces a tech-stack & architecture decision document (overview, architecture style, per-layer choices, diagram, ADRs, dev environment), then iterates on feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user needs to choose a tech stack, make architecture decisions, or document technology selections, e.g. on requests like "define the tech stack" or "choose technologies".

say_en.text: Define the tech stack and architecture for this web app.
say_en.note: It will ask questions first, then produce a decision document.

say_en.text: Generate a tech stack and architecture decision document.
say_en.note: It will analyze known information and output the document.

say_en.text: Write the reasoning and alternatives for this project's tech choices.
say_en.note: It will generate a document with ADRs.
